title: Handmade Hero Day 021 - Loading Game Code Dynamically
summary: Day 21 of Casey Muratori's Handmade Hero, which covers loading game code dynamically from a DLL on Windows. He builds hot reloading of C game code from scratch in about an hour and a half.
why: Recommended as a clear, from-scratch demonstration of how simple code hot-reloading is with plain OS facilities.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Casey Muratori writes a hot-reloading functionality for C from scratch in about an hour
